executiveSummary: Today's AI picture is being shaped by customer operations, model platforms, open-source stack. The strongest signals point to a market where research progress, platform controls, and workflow execution are converging into more operational buying criteria.

Vendor differentiation is moving from model access to operational trust, controls, and ecosystem depth.
The open-source layer is turning into a strategic option set for AI stack design, not only a hobbyist ecosystem.
